text:
nina_cs: TL;DR from 5 onboarding calls today — recurring asks: per-route cost breakdown (hourly granularity requested by 2 customers), admin guided checklist for SOC2/compliance steps, curated prompt templates for PHI handling, and renewal-alerts when usage collapses. Sharing so PM/Eng can triage.

leo_pm: Nice list. Which accounts? Any that are renewal-risk or willing to pay for priority?

nina_cs: Parklane and HelixCardio flagged renewals in the next ~2 months. Parklane said they'd pay for an early per-route billing alpha.

cassie_csm: Snippet: "we need to show cost by feature/route or we'll lose finance sign-off" 1Parklane. HelixCardio: "templates for clinical prompts + redaction would speed adoption."

omar_eng: For per-route visibility we can expose a CSV export first. Backend: aggregate tokens by route/day. Frontend: small table + download. Estimate 3 engineer-days for CSV+query and 2 days for a minimal UI.

lisa_legal: For PHI prompt templates we need a legal checklist and a doc explaining limitations. We should label templates as "recommended" not guaranteed safe.

product-bot: Please file a productboard entry and tag with "renewal-risk" and "onboarding" https://productboard.example/redwood :memo:

leo_pm: Proposed plan: 1) CS confirm Parklane alpha opt-in (nina/cassie) 2) Eng spike CSV and provide example query (omar) 3) PM creates product entry + links call notes (leo) 4) Ship alpha to opt-ins in ~6 weeks. Agree?

nina_cs: Agree. I'll confirm Parklane by EOD and note hourly vs daily billing preference.

omar_eng: Quick query we can use for MVP: ```SELECT route, date_trunc('hour', created_at) as hr, sum(tokens_in+tokens_out) as tokens FROM requests WHERE customer_id = 'parklane' GROUP BY route, hr ORDER BY hr DESC LIMIT 10000;```

cassie_csm: I'll ask Parklane if they'd accept daily buckets for v1 or insist on hourly.

lisa_legal: Also, recommend adding a "template disclaimer" modal and an internal sign-off step before publicizing PHI templates. Happy to review drafts.

leo_pm: OK. Action owners: nina/cassie = confirm customers; omar = spike + example CSV; leo = product ticket; lisa = legal checklist. Update thread when you have confirmations.

nina_cs: Will do. Also capturing: customer ask for an "admin-only guided walkthrough" (step-by-step checklist) + an exportable artifacts pack for audits.

omar_eng: Noted. Exportable artifacts could be a ZIP with config + audit log snippet. Low lift.

leo_pm: Thanks team. If Parklane opts in we move to alpha lane. :rocket:
